title: Additive evaluation of the normalized singleton tensor comparison
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $\mathcal F$ a quasi-coherent module, $U,W$ objects of its small etale site, $g:W\to U$, $n\in\mathbf N$, and $f$ a homomorphism from the lifted Amitsur degree to the singleton Cech degree satisfying [new-etale-affine-singleton-tensor-degree-comparison-hom-normalization]. Let $P$ be the product of $n+1$ copies of $W$ over $U$. There exists an additive map $q$ from the Cech degree to $\Gamma(P,P^*\mathcal F)$ such that $q(f(\operatorname{up}(m\otimes\operatorname{tprod}(b))))=\prod_k\pi_k^*(b_k)\cdot\rho_{P\to U}(m)$ for all coefficient sections $m$ and tuples of functions $b$. The restriction $\rho$ is the normalized restriction from the cited definition.

source.place: Tag 03P2 affine Cech term calculation; additive product evaluation

proof.text: Compose the categorical product projection at the unique function Fin(n+1)→Fin 1 with ULift.down. Both maps are additive. Unfold the normalization predicate to obtain its pure-tensor equation for this composite. No affine hypothesis or generator induction is used.

theorem singletonTensor_normalization_evaluation
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ U) (n : ℕ)
    (f : (singletonTensorAmitsur X F U W g).X n ⟶
      (singletonTensorCech X F U W g).X n)
    (hf : IsSingletonTensorDegreeComparisonHom X F U W g n f) :
    ∃ q : (singletonTensorCech X F U W g).X n →+
      Γ((Modules.tensorPullback (∏ᶜ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Over.mk g)).left.hom).obj F, ⊤),
      letI : Algebra Γ(U.left, ⊤) Γ(W.left, ⊤) := g.left.appTop.hom.toAlgebra
      ∀ m b, q ((AddCommGrpCat.Hom.hom f) (ULift.up (m ⊗ₜ[Γ(U.left, ⊤)]
        PiTensorProduct.tprod Γ(U.left, ⊤) b))) =
        (∏ k : Fin (n + 1),
          (Pi.π (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Over.mk g) k).left.left.appTop (b k)) •
            Modules.etaleTensorSectionsRestriction F
              (∏ᶜ (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) ↦ Over.mk g)).hom m
